_comment: Cardinal number words and the quantity each names — the Slovene half of the
counting-picture production card (tunatale-elrj). See the Norwegian file for
the full rationale; the rules are identical and enforced by the same tests.
⚠️ Untested against a real promotion. Every Slovene number row in
tunatale_sl.db is still `vocab` with no production direction, so none has
reached promote_production_cards yet. This file is the vocabulary that will
route them when they do; it is not evidence that they route correctly.
`values` must be injective ONCE `exclude` is applied. `ena` is the counting
form ('ena, dva, tri') and is the renderable 1. The masculine `en` names the
same quantity and is listed too, but excluded: it is the form most likely to
appear in a lesson as a bare quantifier rather than as a counted one.
